text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq's agriculture minister meets Jordanian counterpart in Amman and discusses increasing cooperation.
- Trade Ministry increases subsidised cooking oil sold among other foodstuffs in its shopping centres to civil servants.
- French dignitaries and students to start visit to Iraq on Saturday.
(The above were also carried by IRAQ and QADISSIYA)
